help: pull a peer room's claude sessions and memory from the store into this machine's live Claude Code store, the peer rooms being its remotes - what it would write is corpus-yoga agent's status, per peer store held; the one adapter that vouches for a write into a live store

args.name: --id
args.help: uuid(8) prefix of the agent to pull - identity is never guessed

args.name: --all
args.help: pull every session the peer transported

args.name: --from
args.help: the peer store to pull from - a machine name (bare token) or a directory (./dir or a path)
